title: Policy question, then asks for a person

turns.customer: Quick question before I use Paylane for something big: how do refunds work? Is there a limit?
turns.reply: In this chat I can refund a settled card purchase of $75.00 or less, in full, if it's under 30 days old, hasn't been refunded before and your card isn't frozen. There's no total cap, since each transaction is judged on its own. Anything over $75 or 30 days or older goes to a person on our support team for review, and so does money sent to another person, which I can't reverse here.
